meta.description: Designs QC, corrects signal drift, removes batch effects, filters features, normalizes samples, and imputes missing values for untargeted LC-MS/GC-MS metabolomics.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported measurements are from fresh scripts or installed-tool output; no fabricated citations, results, or effect sizes were found.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill processes research feature tables and does not diagnose individuals or prescribe treatment.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh runs confirmed held-out-QC validation, degree-aware ComBat caveats, QRILC log-scale round-trip, and the rejection of a batch/group confound.

code_usability.detail: Both shipped R files parsed; the example, real-data pipeline, PQN paths, QRILC paths, and new D-ratio CLI executed. Input 12 exposes a P1 guard-coverage defect, but the code is runnable and the defect is reported below.

functional_suitability.note: Covers QC design, filtering, drift, batch alignment, normalization, and missingness with runnable primary paths.

reliability.note: Strong failure-mode coverage, but the shown QCRSC all-NA assertion is global and misses a sparse-QC batch when another batch is valid.

performance_context.note: A 262-line Skill keeps detailed logic compact; real-data steps are necessarily computationally substantial.

agent_usability.note: Decision trees, pipeline ordering, named functions, and directly adjacent guards make the workflow easy to follow.

human_usability.note: The description and usage guide use natural prompts and explain when the workflow must stop or defer to study design.

security.note: No credentials, network-dependent processing, destructive operations, or user-string evaluation were found.

maintainability.note: The new D-ratio routine is a focused script with a CLI; the mixed-batch guard needs one localized correction.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger language, explicit version checks, related-skill handoffs, and clear escape hatches support composition.

final.deployment_rationale: Deployable under the governing rubric: score and all production floors pass, no veto fired, and there is no open P0. The open P1 is nonblocking; schedule its correction without holding deployment or promotion.

key_strengths: Real MTBLS79 execution validates drift correction on held-out QCs rather than a circular clustering metric.
The repaired QRILC path is physically valid on the exact prior P0 scenario.
PQN factor retrieval works for both plain matrix and SummarizedExperiment inputs.
The newly shipped D-ratio function and CLI discriminate planted clean from noisy features exactly.
The Skill strongly prevents batch-confound and over-correction misinterpretation.

recommendations.title: Make the QCRSC all-NA guard per-batch
recommendations.problem: The displayed guard checks whether any feature has data anywhere in the result. In a multi-batch run, a valid batch makes it pass even when a sparse-QC batch is entirely NA.
recommendations.root_cause: The implementation aggregates row completeness across every sample although the prose says to check immediately per batch.
recommendations.fix: Schedule a follow-up fix: replace the global assertion with a per-batch check, for example loop over unique(batch_id) and stop if all corrected values in any batch are NA; test a mixed valid/sparse-QC batch. This is nonblocking because the governing rubric makes only vetoes and open P0s deployment blockers.
